context: Four men dinner — Hiroshi-boss (retired) + Tatsuya + Daichi + Kenji. Tatsuya talks about new produce techniques.
purpose: four-male friendship continuing — sharing rural expertise

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 達也さん、今夜の野菜、本当に美味しい。
lines.en: Tatsuya-san, tonight's vegetables are truly delicious.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Soft opening on the name. Real appreciation in the voice—not performed, genuinely tasted. A boss who notices good work and says so quietly. Steady composure throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。新しい品種、最近、試してまして。
lines.en: Thank you. I've been trying some new varieties recently.
lines.style: Humble, grounded. Slight pause after the thanks—he's not used to praise and it lands genuinely. Voice settles into the work itself. Patient, quiet warmth. No flourish, just honest craft.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 達也さんの野菜、毎回、進化してる気がする。
lines.en: Every time I have Tatsuya-san's vegetables, they feel like they've evolved.
lines.style: Bright, genuine admiration. Kansai lilt colours the rhythm—warm and open. Leans into 「進化」with real appreciation. The voice of someone who pays attention and says what he notices without holding back.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うちのお客様も、達也さんの野菜、本当に評判いいです。
lines.en: Our customers really love Tatsuya-san's vegetables.
lines.style: Professional warmth with real sincerity underneath. Speaking as the bridge between worlds—office and farm. Each phrase lands clearly. Genuine pride in passing along something good. Steady, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 皆さんのお陰や、ほんま。
lines.en: It's thanks to all of you, truly.
lines.style: Quiet deflection of praise. The voice of someone who means it—the credit goes elsewhere. Kansai warmth in the cadence. Slight exhale on 「ほんま」—worn, grateful, at ease with his people.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 退職してから、こうやって、皆さんと、お食事できるの、本当に楽しい。
lines.en: Since retiring, being able to share meals like this with everyone—it's genuinely joyful.
lines.style: Reflective, tender warmth. A slight softening on 「楽しい」—this matters more than small talk. Measured delivery that feels like he's savouring the moment even as he speaks it. Composed but unguarded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 田中さんが、まだ、こうやって、一緒にいてくれるの、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so happy Tanaka-san is still here with us like this.
lines.style: Kansai openness, emotional honesty without sentimentality. Warm emphasis on 「一緒にいてくれるの」—real affection, unashamed. The bright relief of someone who cares deeply and gets to say it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これからも、ずっと、お時間、いただきたい。
lines.en: Going forward, I'd love to keep having your time.
lines.style: Formal politeness wrapped around sincere longing. The voice of someone asking quietly for continuity. Steady, earnest. Not pleading—just honest about what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろん。皆さんとの時間、私の宝物。
lines.en: Of course. Time with all of you is my treasure.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The word 「宝物」lands with real weight—not overstated, genuinely felt. Composed authority softened by deep warmth. A man who doesn't say everything but means what he does.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: こうやって、ずっと、繋がっていきたい。
lines.en: I want us to stay connected like this, always.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Kansai warmth grounding the sentiment. No rush, no performance—just the voice of someone who has learned what matters and won't pretend otherwise. Steady, gentle conviction.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: わいの赤ちゃん、皆さんに、見せに行きますわ。
lines.en: I'm going to bring my baby to show all of you.
lines.style: Bright Kansai joy, unguarded pride. Quick tempo, almost bubbling with the news. The warmth of someone bursting to share his life with people he trusts. Open, generous, genuine excitement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Sincere anticipation, warmly formal. Brief, genuine—no excess. The voice of someone saying exactly what he means and meaning what he says. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 乾杯しましょう。皆さんと、達也さんと、メイさんの将来に。
lines.en: Let's raise a toast. To all of us, to Tatsuya-san, and to Mei-san's future.
lines.style: A boss rallying his people with real tenderness underneath. Gathering weight as the toast builds. The authority to call people together and the humility to include himself. Clear, warm, inclusive.
